interpretations: Ratio per record is boxy/boxz, averaged per funding source (AVG of ratios), with records where boxy or boxz is NULL ignored; the count covers all spatial records in the group
Ratio per record is boxy/boxz, averaged per funding source, with the count taken only over records that have non-null boxy and boxz
Ratio is the sum of boxy divided by the sum of boxz per source (ratio of totals) instead of the average of per-record ratios
Records with boxz = 0 are excluded or yield a null ratio (division by zero avoided), and the ratio is averaged over the rest
Records with boxz = 0 cause an error or are kept as infinite or undefined values
Projects with NULL fundflux form one group, labeled e.g. 'Unknown'
Projects with an empty-string fundflux are also treated as missing and merged into the NULL group
Empty-string fundflux is a separate group from NULL
Spatial records whose arcref has no matching project are dropped (inner join)
Spatial records with no matching project are kept as their own group with a NULL funding source (left join from scanspatial)
Funding sources with no spatial records are excluded and are not counted in the cross-source average (inner join)
Funding sources with zero spatial records are included in the cross-source average, lowering the threshold (left join from projects)
The cross-source average is the unweighted mean of per-source counts, that is, total records divided by the number of funding sources
The cross-source average is the mean count per project or per record, not per funding source
"Above" is a strict greater-than, so sources equal to the average are excluded
"Above" is greater-than-or-equal, so sources equal to the average are kept
The output "average of the kept sources' ratios" is the unweighted mean of the per-source average ratios
The output "average of the kept sources' ratios" is weighted by record count, which is the same as the overall mean of per-record ratios over kept sources
The "total of their spatial record counts" is the sum of counts over the kept sources
The "average amount by which their counts exceed the cross-source average" is the mean of (count − average) over the kept sources
The excess average is computed as (kept sources' mean count) − (cross-source average), which is numerically the same as interpretation
If no source exceeds the average, the single row has NULL averages and a total of 0 or NULL
If no source exceeds the average, no row is returned
The cross-source average is computed after the null-ratio filtering, so groups are built only from records with non-null boxy and boxz
The cross-source average is computed over all records before any filtering on ratio nullity
The funding source is compared case-sensitively and whitespace-sensitively, so variants such as 'Government' and 'government ' form separate groups
The funding source is normalized for case or whitespace before grouping, merging such variants
No rounding is applied to any of the three output values, so full precision is returned
Several spatial records for the same project each count separately, so a project with more records weighs more in its source's count
Spatial records are counted per distinct project, or distinct domainregistry, rather than per row, which only matters if the join duplicates rows
Ratio of averages per source, AVG(boxy)/AVG(boxz), instead of the average of per-record ratios or the ratio of sums
A source whose per-record ratios are all NULL stays in the kept set through its count, but is skipped when averaging the ratios
Placeholder strings in fundflux, such as 'Unknown', 'N/A' or whitespace-only values, are also treated as missing and merged into the NULL group
The cross-source average is computed over the sources' counts after excluding the NULL group, with only non-null named sources compared against it
queries:
SELECT p.fundflux, AVG(s.boxy / s.boxz) AS avg_ratio, COUNT(*) AS record_count
FROM scanspatial s
JOIN projects p ON s.arcref = p.arcregistry
GROUP BY p.fundflux

SELECT p.fundflux, AVG(s.boxy / s.boxz) AS avg_ratio
FROM scanspatial s
JOIN projects p ON s.arcref = p.arcregistry
WHERE s.boxy IS NOT NULL AND s.boxz IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY p.fundflux
SELECT arcref, SUM(boxy) * 1.0 / SUM(boxz) AS ratio FROM scanspatial GROUP BY arcref
SELECT AVG(volm3 * 1.0 / boxz) FROM scanspatial WHERE boxz <> 0;
SELECT domainregistry FROM scanspatial WHERE boxz = 0;
